title: Derived coefficient-tower pairing constructions and finite frames
statement: Define integral global sections after constant scalar restriction, the integral and finite global derived Hom functors, finite compact-support sections, the simultaneous tower support and Hom functors, and their tensor. A pairing system and its finite frames consist of the displayed compactification adjunctions and tensor comparisons. Their pairing is the actual composite of the projection mates, evaluation and compact-support counit. The setting and constituent notions are those of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], [lem-coef-finite-dualizing], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point], [def-coef-tower-trace-constructions], [lem-pc-kflat-resolution], [lem-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-functor], [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], [lem-weil-tower-evaluation-kinjective], [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact], [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data], [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed].
